heading: Tuesday, June 10, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Mistral AI Magistral and OpenAI o3-pro.

items.headline: Mistral releases Magistral, its first reasoning models
items.summary: Magistral is Mistral's first reasoning model family: Magistral Small, a 24B open-weight model under Apache 2.0, and Magistral Medium, an enterprise model in Le Chat and the API. Mistral reports 73.6% on AIME 2024 for Magistral Medium and 70.7% for Small, and published a companion paper.

items.headline: OpenAI releases o3-pro
items.summary: o3-pro is a version of o3 that uses more compute to think longer, replacing o1-pro for ChatGPT Pro and Team users and launching in the API at $20/$80 per million input/output tokens. OpenAI says expert reviewers preferred it over o3.
